scope: Reviewed feature and selected ADR decision records, regression tests, execution summaries, and continuation backlog. This is a partial audit.
counts_are_not_coverage: Records overlap and may contain compound requirements; execution and existing test paths do not prove assertion quality or exhaustive coverage.
local_evidence: Log names and scratchpad paths identify local evidence. Raw PDF extracts, annotations, account usage logs, tool installations and unreviewed drafts are intentionally not exported.
reproduction: Run cargo test -p <crate> --test <target> for an integration-test reference; use the named test filter for inline modules. expected-failures.json lists intentionally failing audit regressions. Broad run: cargo nextest run -p pdf-syntax -p pdf-model -p pdf-colour -p pdf-archive -p pdf-transform -p viewer-core -p render-cpu -p viewer-qt -p viewer-host --no-fail-fast. viewer-ui outline_count_audit was run separately.
